data.name: Aslamat
data.gender_notes: Aslamat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name for a girl that means she will be protected and safe. Derived from the Arabic word 'aslama', meaning to submit or surrender, and carrying the connotation of peace and security. The name Aslamat carries the meaning “Secure, safe, protected” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aslamat usually hope their child will grow to embody secure, safe, protected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the inner peace and tranquility of the soul. It signifies the strength and courage that comes from surrendering to the will of Allah.
data.etymology: Aslamat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Secure, safe, protected.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aslamat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.name: اسلامت
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامت، ایک اسلامی نام ہے، یہ اسلام، اطمینان، توحید، ایمان، اور اسلامیت سے متعلق ہے
